from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.routes import notes_bp

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.secret_key = 'your_secret_key_here'

    # Register the notes blueprint
    app.register_blueprint(notes_bp)

    # Initialize the database with the app
    db.init_app(app)

    # Create database tables
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()

    # Define a home route
    @app.route('/')
    def home():
        return "Welcome to the Simple Note-Taking App!"

    return app

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

# app/models/note.py

from app.database import db

class Note(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'notes'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    content = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<Note {self.title}>'

from app import create_app

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = create_app()
    app.run(debug=True)

# Simple Note-Taking App

An application that allows users to enter and save text on a single page.

## Features

- Text Entry: Allows users to input text on a single page.
- Save Notes: Enables users to save the entered text for future reference.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
